ContainerWidth.helper: Layout. Controls the maximum width of the inner content container.

ImagePosition.helper: Layout. Places the image card on desktop or hides the image card entirely. Mobile stacks the image sensibly when visible.

MarginTop.title: Margin (top)
MarginTop.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling spacing above this section.

MarginBottom.title: Margin (bottom)
MarginBottom.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling spacing below this section.

PaddingTop.title: Padding (top)
PaddingTop.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling inner spacing above the content.

PaddingBottom.title: Padding (bottom)
PaddingBottom.helper: Spacing. Optional utility class controlling inner spacing below the content.

BackgroundColorClass.helper: Background / motif. Choose a shared Bootstrap/site background utility. Text contrast is handled for dark theme backgrounds.

ImageTreatment.helper: Image styling. Controls whether the hero image renders in grayscale or full color.
